list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Three samarium ions form a triangular core bridged by three coplanar chlorides; two additional chlorides bridge all three samarium centers, one above and one below the plane. Each Sm is also coordinated by a terminal pentamethylcyclopentadienyl ligand and THF.

synthesis.procedure: Under nitrogen in a glovebox containing coordinating solvents, tert-butyl chloride was added to a stirred solution of compound 1 in benzene. The mixture was filtered and solvent removed under vacuum; THF vapor diffusion into an NMR tube afforded crystals suitable for X-ray analysis.
synthesis.temperature: 25 °C for THF vapor diffusion; reaction temperature not stated
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Nitrogen-atmosphere glovebox; stirred reaction; crystallization by THF vapor diffusion in an NMR tube
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtered and evaporated solvent under vacuum to obtain a red solid; THF vapor diffusion into an NMR tube gave a few red crystals.
synthesis.yield: Low yield; numerical yield not reported

title: Displacement, reduction, and ligand redistribution reactivity of the cationic mono-C5Me5Ln2+ complexes (C5Me5)Ln(BPh4) (Ln = Sm, Yb)
